title: OMG SysML v2.0 Language manual visual ledger: Sections 8.4.7-8.4.17

source.title: OMG Systems Modeling Language (SysML) Version 2.0, Part 1: Language Specification

scope.notes: Every closed SysML source panel visually identified on printed pages 409-450 is recorded. Explicit KerML equivalents, literal ellipsis panels, and a historical malformed connection definition remain exclusions.

review_method: Rendered physical pages 441-482 were inspected page by page. PDF text extraction was used only for navigation and token cross-checking; rendered layout determined panel boundaries, comments, indentation, and cross-page continuations.
